protocol.starts: teleport to the demo's row-0 (qpos,qvel), mj_forward; t=0 obs = dataset obs[row0] (G4 / torchfb part B convention)
protocol.policy: bfm_act.WaypointTracker sliding waypoint (monotone nearest-progress + delta lookahead), actor = sample_actions(obs, goals=waypoint_obs, temperature=0), batched over demos
protocol.window: CONTRACT DEVIATION: demos are each held-out episode's FIRST track_len transitions (play episodes are 1001 rows; the singletask env TimeLimit is 200)
protocol.metrics: tracking_metrics: time-aligned L2 path error on raw hit-spec coords; waypoint hit-rate + completion via spec.contains at eps_mult
protocol.shuffled_control: conditioning row k -> perm[k] (seeded non-identity permutation per demo); progress + metrics vs the TRUE demo
